title: HubExtended
description: CustomCosmetics is a client-side companion mod designed exclusively for the PokéHub Minecraft server.
body:
CustomCosmetics is a client-side companion mod designed exclusively for the PokéHub Minecraft server. It enhances the cosmetic experience by providing a polished, interactive in-game interface that connects directly to the server's cosmetic system.  

Features:  

Custom Cosmetic Menu — Opens with a configurable keybind (default: C). Displays all available cosmetics organized into tabs: Backpack and Wings.  
Live Player Preview — A real-time 3D render of your own character is displayed inside the menu. You can drag to rotate and scroll to zoom, letting you see exactly how a cosmetic looks on your skin before equipping it.  
Server-Synced Cosmetic List — The list of available cosmetics is fetched directly from the PokéHub server when you log in, so it always reflects the current season's offerings without requiring a mod update.  
Search & Scroll — A built-in search bar filters cosmetics by name in real time. A scrollable list with a visible scrollbar handles large cosmetic catalogs cleanly.  
Backpack & Wings Rendering — Equipped cosmetics are rendered as a custom layer directly on your player model in the world, visible to other players who also have the mod installed.  
Optional Client Installation — The mod is not required to join PokéHub. Players without it simply won't see cosmetics rendered on others or have access to the GUI. No crashes, no errors for vanilla or other-modded clients.  
Packet-Based Sync — Cosmetic state (item, position offsets, rotation, scale) is sent from the server to each client individually, allowing per-cosmetic positioning adjustments configured server-side.  



Without this mod, cosmetics on PokéHub are managed through server commands with no visual feedback. With CustomCosmetics installed, you get a dedicated menu that shows you every available cosmetic, lets you preview it on your character in real time, and equips it instantly — all without leaving the game or typing a single command.
